scope: Potential score duplication across existing pkn_lipid_rules metabolite nodes and their adjacent reaction instances. No PKN edge or node was created, and no MOON analysis was fitted.

tier_definitions.existing_measured_species_rule: Existing measured-species LINEX2 rule node in pkn_lipid_rules; this is a chain-matched reaction hypothesis, not a curated ChEBI species reaction.
tier_definitions.exact_reported_resolution: SwissLipids candidate with the same canonical shorthand at the reported nomenclature resolution and a ChEBI identifier.
tier_definitions.compatible_more_specific: SwissLipids candidate carrying extra structural detail. It may resolve sn position, double-bond position/geometry, or stereochemistry, so it is not restricted to positional isomers.
tier_definitions.compatible_lower_resolution: SwissLipids aggregate species candidate. It can preserve class and total carbon:double-bond composition, but not the measured acyl-chain partition.
tier_definitions.compatible_headgroup_isomer: Compatible SwissLipids headgroup isomer, such as a glucose/galactose alternative for an unresolved hexosylceramide.
tier_definitions.generic_diacyl_class_template: Generic Rhea 1,2-diacyl class participant used by the measured-species rule builder. This is a broad class-template stress test, not a species or sn-position mapping.
tier_definitions.hierarchy_class: SwissLipids class-level annotation. It intentionally discards molecular species identity.
tier_definitions.hierarchy_ancestor: SwissLipids non-class ancestor annotation. It is broader than the measured species and may overlap a compatible candidate.

native_position_or_structure_relaxed.interpretation: A score would be copied to every distinct active PKN metabolite node supported by these tiers; counts are a sensitivity burden, not evidence that all assignments are true.

important_limitations: compatible_more_specific includes more than sn-position ambiguity; it can add stereochemical or double-bond-detail candidates.
compatible_lower_resolution discards the observed acyl-chain partition and is not a positional-isomer policy.
generic_diacyl_class_template and hierarchy tiers are broad class-level stress tests, not species-resolved mappings.

The frozen mapping intentionally does not exhaustively retain detailed SwissLipids isomers without a ChEBI identifier; such records cannot be assigned to the current ChEBI-addressed PKN without inventing nodes.
This audit uses the unnormalised pkn_lipid_rules; pH 7.3 aliases belong to the separate pkn_lipid_curated_ph73 sensitivity resource.
Adjacent reaction instances describe qualitative PKN traversal. They do not establish substrate specificity, tissue flux, or biochemical activity in the samples.
